name: Automatic Logout and Session Loss
definition: Users experiencing involuntary logout from the app without warning, losing access to their accounts and saved data like liked songs after updates or app closures.

name: Difficult Device Access Management
definition: Users unable to self-manage device access and remote sign-out without contacting customer support, requiring support intervention to remove old devices.

name: Login and Authentication Failures
definition: Users unable to log in to their accounts on mobile devices or specific platforms, receiving error messages or being unable to authenticate with email, phone number, or social login methods.

name: Other access problems
definition: Access complaints that fit no other access issue.

name: Excessive Premium Paywall on Basic Features
definition: Core music player functionality previously free now locked behind premium paywall, including shuffle, song skipping, looping, and playback controls.

name: Other billing problems
definition: Billing complaints that fit no other billing issue.

name: Premium Features Unavailable or Degraded
definition: Paid premium users unable to access promised features like lyrics, audiobooks, or experiencing ads despite active subscription.

name: Lyrics Display and Loading Issues
definition: Lyrics feature not loading, displaying incorrectly, or becoming unavailable for extended periods across multiple songs and user types.

name: Other catalog problems
definition: Catalog complaints that fit no other catalog issue.

name: Poor Recommendation Algorithm and Autoplay Issues
definition: App inserting unwanted songs into playlists, playing songs different from user selection, or ignoring user recommendation settings.

name: Missing or Unsearchable Songs
definition: Popular songs, specific artists, or regional music unavailable in the catalog or failing to appear in search results despite being on the platform.

name: Download Feature Restricted to Premium
definition: Free users unable to download songs for offline listening, with download functionality locked behind premium paywall.

name: Downloaded Songs Disappearing or Failing to Persist
definition: Downloaded playlists or songs automatically deleting, requiring constant re-downloading, or vanishing after app updates or phone restarts.

name: Slow or Non-Functional Offline Playback
definition: Downloaded songs taking excessive time to load in offline mode or failing to play despite successful download, making offline listening unusable.

name: Other downloads problems
definition: Downloads complaints that fit no other downloads issue.

name: General dissatisfaction
definition: Negative reviews with no specific product problem stated.

name: Other playback problems
definition: Playback complaints that fit no other playback issue.

name: False No Internet Connection Errors During Playback
definition: App showing no internet connection error or interrupting playback even when device has active internet connection.

name: App Crashes and Playback Freezes
definition: App crashing during playback, stopping unexpectedly after one song, or requiring frequent force-closes to function.

name: Wrong Song Playing When Selected
definition: App playing different song than the one user selected or clicked on, or unexpected songs randomly added to playback.

name: Inadequate Support for Account Security Issues
definition: Customer support unable to help with hacked accounts, unauthorized access, or account recovery, leaving users without recourse.

name: Other support problems
definition: Support complaints that fit no other support issue.

name: Slow and Unresponsive Customer Support
definition: Customer support taking hours to respond, ignoring messages, or providing scripted unhelpful responses without resolution.

name: Support Failing to Resolve Billing Disputes
definition: Customer support unable or unwilling to refund, credit, or resolve billing issues such as unauthorized charges or premium access problems.

name: Excessive Ads in Free Tier
definition: Free users experiencing ads appearing every few songs or continuously, disrupting music listening experience.

name: Interface Issues and Update-Related Usability Degradation
definition: Major UI changes causing confusion, slow loading times, or removal of familiar features after updates making app harder to use.

name: Other usability problems
definition: Usability complaints that fit no other usability issue.

name: Missing or Locked Playback Controls
definition: Users unable to access basic controls like repeat/loop, song skipping, or forward/backward navigation in songs.
